EBAS is developed and operated by the Norwegian Institute for Air Research (NILU). dmp.description: This plan describes management of data collected during the EU-funded CARGO-ACT project. The CARGO-ACT project intends to harmonize procedures and data management between U.S. American and European research infrastructures observing the properties of short-lived atmospheric constituents, i.e. aerosol particles, clouds, and reactive trace gases. This DMP doesn't cover management of data collected during normal operations of these infrastructures, only the data collected during the CARGO-ACT project.
dmp.title: CARGO-ACT Data Management Plan
